sources.citation: Wurm, S. A. 1971. Notes on the linguistic situation in the Trans-Fly area. In Dutton, Voorhoeve & Wurm, Papers in New Guinea Linguistics No. 14, 115-172. Pacific Linguistics A-28. Canberra: ANU.
sources.note: Sec. 3.35.12.3, p. 156 (Tonda Sub-Family as a whole, not Rema): 'The suprasegmental system appears to manifest itself as a fairly complex stress system with rhythm principles, but no tonal system appears to be present.' No locus given. Wereave listed as a village of Wurm's 'Tonda' language (p. 155); Rema/Bothar not named.

sources.citation: Carroll, Matthew J., Wolfgang Barth, Nicholas Evans, I Wayan Arka, Christian Döhler, Eri Kashima, Volker Gast, Tina Gregor, Kate L. Lindsey, Julia Miller, Emil Mittag, Bruno Olsson, Dineke Schokkin, Jeff Siegel, Charlotte van Tongeren & Kyla Quinn. 2024. Yamfinder: Southern New Guinea Lexical Database (CLDF dataset v1.0, lexibank/yamfinder; Zenodo 10843349). Rema list: Mittag, Emil, fieldwork data, village Wereave, 371 items.
sources.note: No phonology content: 371 lexical forms in a practical orthography (acute/grave accents on vowels are vowel-quality letters of the Tonda orthographies, e.g. émú, mbésóm, tèfèle), Phonetic/Phonemic fields empty except one item, no audio files, no stress or tone marks, no transcription note for Rema in /. Wordlist-only data, not a statement.
